5840.title: Context wrappers discard typed CLI error metadata
5840.rootCauseOneLine: prependErrorContext replaces typed errors with plain Error, so actionErrorCode falls back to error.
5840.proposedFix: Retain typed error metadata while adding context; verify the exact managed-job refusal after its prerequisite reaches trusted main.
5840.caveats: Two clean built-CLI runs reproduce SDK code loss, not the managed-job-specific transport guard, which is absent from trusted main. No fix PR.
